title: Fuchsfelge fur Porsche - Schmiederad Aluminium (product page)
notes: German product page read on 2026-10-15. It lists forged aluminium (Schmiederad, Aluminium) wheels with finish suffixes .011, .012 and .013, including 37024 (7J x 17 ET55, 7.50 kg), 37025 (8J x 17 ET52, 7.70 kg), 37026 (9J x 17 ET55, 7.95 kg), 37027 (8J x 18 ET52, 8.20 kg) and 37028 (10J x 18 ET65, 8.80 kg). The application cell of the 17-inch rows names 993 and 993 Turbo; that of the 18-inch rows names 993 Turbo but not 993, while the KBA approvals 000087/000088 and the July 2020 leaflet also admit the 18-inch pair on the 993 Carrera: see catalog/registers/contradictions.json. The page offers a technical data sheet on request and no download. Inline component citation: FUCHS-PRODUCT in the four COMP-FUCHS records.
